# Totally RAD Radio

> A premium, clutter-free internet radio station broadcasting retro hits from the 1980s, 1990s, and early 2000s across pop, rock, rap, R&B, and alternative genres.

## Quick Links
- **Website:** https://totallyradradio.com
- **Listen Live:** https://totallyradradio.com/#listen
- **LLC / Operator:** SuiteSounds Entertainment, LLC

## Programming & Format
- **Genres & Formats:** 80s, 90s, and 2000s Pop, Rock, Rap, R&B, and Alternative.
- **Programming Philosophy:** Music-intensive presentation focused purely on retro hits with minimal commercial interruption.
- **Morning Show:** *The Van Camp & Morgan Show* (Weekdays).

## Smart Home & Voice Integration
- **Amazon Alexa Skill:** Enable the "Totally RAD Radio" skill on Amazon Alexa devices.
- **Voice Command:** Say *"Alexa, play Totally RAD Radio"* or *"Alexa, open Totally RAD Radio"*.

## Audio Stream Specifications
The station utilizes high-fidelity audio processing optimized for crystal-clear sound across home setups, mobile devices, and internet radio platforms.

- **Standard Stream:** 128 kbps LC-AAC (Advanced Audio Coding - Low Complexity)
- **Mobile / Low-Bandwidth Stream:** 64 kbps HE-AAC (High-Efficiency Advanced Audio Coding)
